mapper.select: SELECT a.*, e.name AS exam_name, es.subject_name AS subject_name, s.name AS student_name, c.name AS class_name FROM answer_sheet a LEFT JOIN exam e ON e.id = a.exam_id LEFT JOIN exam_subject es ON es.id = a.exam_subject_id LEFT JOIN student s ON s.id = a.student_id LEFT JOIN class_info c ON c.id = s.class_id WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.deleted = 0

SELECT a.*, e.name AS exam_name, es.subject_name AS subject_name, s.name AS student_name, c.name AS class_name FROM answer_sheet a LEFT JOIN exam e ON e.id = a.exam_id LEFT JOIN exam_subject es ON es.id = a.exam_subject_id LEFT JOIN student s ON s.id = a.student_id LEFT JOIN class_info c ON c.id = s.class_id WHERE a.exam_subject_id = #{examSubjectId} AND a.deleted = 0 ORDER BY a.student_number ASC
